description: Danbury Square is a thriving 193,657 square foot regional shopping center strategically located next to the Danbury Fair Mall at 13 & 15 Backus Avenue in Danbury, Connecticut. This well-established community destination serves the affluent Danbury market with a diverse mix of national retailers and local businesses that cater to everyday shopping needs. Key tenants include Hobby Lobby for crafts and home décor, Ocean State Job Lot for value shopping, David's Bridal for special occasions, Planet Fitness for health and wellness, and Elicit Brewing Company for dining and entertainment. With over 1.2 million annual visits, the center has become an integral part of the local retail landscape, drawing from a trade area of nearly 54,000 residents with an average household income of $118,794. The property's proximity to Danbury Fair Mall creates a powerful retail cluster that attracts shoppers throughout Fairfield County and beyond, offering convenient access and ample parking for the community's shopping, dining, and service needs.
